meta.title: Hartwell & Okafor | Family, wills and probate law, Islington
meta.description: A small Islington law practice for divorce, children arrangements, wills, lasting powers of attorney and probate. Fixed fees where we can. Free 20 minute first call.

rationale: Slate teal in one hue, light on the page and very deep for text, gives a hushed, serious room for people who arrive worried. The quiet statement hero, a letter from the partners and a conversation about the first call carry the calm, while the huge '20' and one hand-drawn desk scene make the page memorable and point to the one action: booking the free call.

props.statement: Divorce, a will, a parent's estate. These are hard things to start. The first twenty minutes on the phone with us cost nothing.
props.detail: Two partners and a paralegal in Islington. Family law, wills and lasting powers of attorney, and probate, with a fixed fee wherever the work allows it.

props.caption: free first call, to hear what you are facing and what it would cost

featured.name: Family law
featured.description: Divorce, separation, and the arrangements for your children: where they live, when they see each parent, how money is split. We explain each step in plain sentences before you have to decide anything, and we give you a fixed fee where the work allows it.

photo.subject: The meeting-room table at Hartwell & Okafor with a notepad, a box of tissues and two cups of tea, daylight from the window, nobody posing

others.name: Wills and lasting powers of attorney
others.description: A will that says what you mean. A lasting power of attorney so someone you trust can act for you if you cannot.

others.name: Probate
others.description: Dealing with the estate after a death: the forms, the bank, the sale of a house. We do the paperwork and tell you where it has got to.

pairs.ask: Do I need to have my papers ready?
pairs.answer: No. Tell us what has happened in your own order. We ask the questions that matter and write nothing down that you have not said.

pairs.ask: Will you tell me what it costs?
pairs.answer: Yes, before the call ends. Where the work is clear we quote a fixed fee. Where it is not, we say why and give you the hourly rate.

pairs.ask: What if I only want to ask one thing?
pairs.answer: Then that is the call. Twenty minutes is yours, and nobody will push you to sign up.

pairs.ask: What happens if I decide to go ahead?
pairs.answer: We send you a short letter with the fee and the first three steps. After that, one of us is your point of contact.

paragraphs: Most people who ring us have never needed a solicitor before. They are tired, a bit frightened of the bill, and unsure whether their problem is big enough to bother anyone with. It is.
We started a small practice so that the person who answers the phone is the person who knows your file. There are two of us, Clare and Tunde, and a paralegal who keeps every case moving.
Ring for the free twenty minutes. If we can help, we will tell you what it costs. If someone else can help you better, we will say so.
props.name: Clare Hartwell and Tunde Okafor
